Chapter 7153: Dead

Chapter 7153: Dead

The divine beasts hid behind intertwining rivers of time and dimensions. Furthermore, they served as barriers once detected.

They twisted together and formed a nest with Skykiller Palace at the center. Around the nest were individual dimensional pockets housing divine beasts.

The foundation of this nest was beyond the means of a celestial immortal, having been formed naturally.

“Now this is an ancestral nest.” Li Qiye said softly: “Nest of Life, I see, impressive.”

“Rumble!” Figures landed to stop his path - Kun Peng, Death Serpent, Lunar Wolf...

“This only makes it easier for me.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Sir, please spare our race.” Kun Peng bowed deeply.

“I never said anything about destroying your race, I just want your heads.” Li Qiye smiled.

Death Serpent and the others were furious but Kun Peng stopped them and said: “Would you be satisfied with our heads?”

“You would offer it willingly?” Li Qiye clapped, seemingly amused.

“If that can ease your annoyance, then yes, we will offer our heads.” Kun Peng said.

“Third Brother!” The others shouted unwillingly.

“Sir, we are willing to pay any price, our heads included.” Kun Peng repeated.

“You can read the situation on top of being heroic. Unfortunately, there is no room for negotiation.” Li Qiye shook his head.

Kun Peng’s expression soured.

“You believe that offering your head shows sincerity and will move me. However, it is a meaningless act in my eyes. Your fate was determined the moment you chose to refine Divine Firmament, no one can stop me from killing you all. Offering your head is actually a good thing for you since that will spare you some misery.” Li Qiye said.

“What more do you want, Sir?” Kun Peng asked.

“Phoenix Queen’s life too.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Such arrogance!” Lunar Wolf wanted to attack but was stopped again by Kun Peng.

“Why are you agitated, isn’t Phoenix Queen already dead?” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, we cannot hand over the dead, so you should just take our lives, Sir.” Kun Peng said.

“Paper cannot stop fire.” Li Qiye said: “I’ll change my answer a bit, I want Hidden Immortal’s life.”

“Hidden Immortal is not here.” Gluttonous Beast said.

“Qing Ji was branded a traitor who joined Immortal Hunt Alliance. From what I can tell, you all were the ones who joined this alliance, serving as its pillars.” Li Qiye said.

The divine beasts’ expression changed.

“Immortal Hunt, so mysterious.” Li Qiye said: “No one knew its headquarters because it was located in the isolated Divine Firmament.”

“Sir, we don’t know anything about this alliance you speak of, or Hidden Immortal.” Kun Peng said.

“Since the dragon servants are your slaves, you all didn’t do anything to them and chose outside immortals instead. However, they couldn’t have been fed to the young ones or Xiao Yue would have known.” Li Qiye said: “What were they used for?”

“Sir, you accuse without evidence.” Kun Peng changed his tone.

“Let me guess, you all wanted to experiment to boost population, using flesh and blood as nourishment for a nest. But, even your ruler’s flesh and blood couldn’t do it, how could outsiders’ corpses work?” Li Qiye said.

“Lies!” Lunar Wolf shouted.

“It appears you all weren’t personally involved.” Li Qiye said before staring at Gluttonous: “But you were sealed, right? You thought His Majesty shouldn’t have been treated that way. You knew this secret and went against it.”

“Sir, that is enough.” Kun Peng said.
